plans.name: narrow-calendar-employee-date
plans.scope: own audience through actual noninlined security-definer predicate, 93 days
plans.sql:
SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
 'employeeId',r.employee_id,'employeeName',u.full_name,'date',to_char(d.day,'YYYY-MM-DD'),
 'approvedMinutes',d.charged_minutes,'availabilityLabel',
 CASE WHEN d.charged_minutes=d.scheduled_minutes THEN 'full_scheduled_absence' ELSE 'partial_absence' END)
 ORDER BY d.day,u.full_name,r.employee_id),'[]'::jsonb)
 FROM public.ihr_leave_requests r JOIN public.ihr_leave_request_days d ON d.request_id=r.id
 JOIN public.users u ON u.id=r.employee_id
 WHERE r.status IN('approved','cancellation_pending') AND d.charged_minutes>0 AND d.day BETWEEN '2026-01-01'::date AND '2026-04-03'::date
 AND private.ihr_leave_calendar_can_read('9c5e86eb-49a6-4277-a180-10415611e0a4'::uuid,r.employee_id,'own',statement_timestamp())
plans.authorityEvidence: underlying SELECT only; actual authenticated RPC permission assertions are separate

plans.name: narrow-private-hr-history-cursor
plans.scope: one request, exact time/UUID cursor, 50 events and original projection joins
plans.sql:
SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',e.id,'event',e.event,'atTime',e.at_time,'actor',jsonb_build_object('id',e.actor_id,'name',u.full_name),
'reason',CASE WHEN e.event='reassigned' THEN reassignment.reason WHEN e.event IN('rejected','cancellation_requested','cancellation_declined') AND jsonb_typeof(e.data->'reason')='string' THEN e.data->>'reason' ELSE NULL END,
'approverName',CASE WHEN e.event IN('submitted','opening_imported') THEN 'Fictional Capacity 481' WHEN e.event='reassigned' THEN reassignment.assignment_source->>'approver_name'
 WHEN e.event IN('cancellation_requested','cancellation_accepted','cancellation_declined') THEN attempt.approver_name
 WHEN e.event IN('approved','rejected') THEN coalesce(decision_route.assignment_source->>'approver_name','Fictional Capacity 481') ELSE NULL END) ORDER BY e.at_time DESC,e.id DESC),'[]')
FROM(SELECT * FROM private.ihr_leave_request_events WHERE request_id='46e349c3-e2ec-49e1-a977-027dbfb625d4'::uuid AND (at_time,id)<('2024-01-01T00:01:14.000000Z'::timestamptz,'bd6c4adf-4cef-4472-a68e-dc70f6ca86ab'::uuid) ORDER BY at_time DESC,id DESC LIMIT 50)e
JOIN public.users u ON u.id=e.actor_id
LEFT JOIN private.ihr_leave_request_reassignments reassignment ON e.event='reassigned' AND reassignment.request_id='46e349c3-e2ec-49e1-a977-027dbfb625d4'::uuid AND reassignment.request_version::text=e.data->>'requestVersion'
LEFT JOIN private.ihr_leave_cancellation_attempts attempt ON attempt.request_id='46e349c3-e2ec-49e1-a977-027dbfb625d4'::uuid AND attempt.id::text=e.data->>'attemptId'
LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT rr.assignment_source FROM private.ihr_leave_request_reassignments rr WHERE rr.request_id='46e349c3-e2ec-49e1-a977-027dbfb625d4'::uuid AND rr.created_at<=e.at_time ORDER BY rr.request_version DESC LIMIT 1)decision_route ON e.event IN('approved','rejected')
plans.authorityEvidence: underlying SELECT only; actual authenticated RPC permission assertions are separate
